subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.**

Elisabeth stood at the piano, which did nothing to **__**allay**__ his anxiety.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4 (aggravate)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"allay"** means to diminish or put at rest (fear, suspicion, or worry). (कम करना, शांत करना)

 
 
• **Example: **She tried to allay their fears by explaining the situation clearly.
 
 
 
• **"Aggravate"** means to make a problem, injury, or offense worse or more serious. (बढ़ाना, बिगाड़ना)
 
 
• **Example: **His comments only served to aggravate the situation.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'allay'** is **'aggravate'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4 (aggravate)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Mitigate** (कम करना): To make less severe, serious, or painful.

 
 
• **Example:** Steps were taken to mitigate the impact of the storm.
 
 
 
• **Simplify** (सरल बनाना): To make something simpler or easier to do or understand.
 
 
• **Example:** The software aims to simplify the management process.
 
 
 
• **Mollify** (शांत करना): To appease the anger or anxiety of someone.
 
 
• **Example:** He tried to mollify his critics with an apology.
 
 

3b:T46b,
The correct answer is 'Option 2'.
